title: Bill Maher receives Mark Twain Prize amid Kennedy Center's Trump-era challenges
summary: Comedian Bill Maher was awarded the Mark Twain Prize for American Humor at the Kennedy Center in Washington D.C. The event occurred amidst what Associated Press described as "Trump-era upheaval" at the arts complex. The Guardian noted jokes were made about a thwarted bid to rename a building after Donald Trump.
summary_points: Bill Maher received the Mark Twain Prize for American Humor.
The award ceremony took place at the Kennedy Center in Washington D.C.
The event occurred during a period of "Trump-era upheaval" at the Kennedy Center.
The Guardian reported jokes were made about a failed attempt to rename a building after Donald Trump.
A large tarpaulin remained to conceal the outcome of the renaming bid.
title_hi: बिल मैहर को केनेडी सेंटर के ट्रम्प-युग की चुनौतियों के बीच मिला मार्क ट्वेन पुरस्कार
summary_hi: हास्य कलाकार बिल मैहर को वाशिंगटन डी.सी. में केनेडी सेंटर में अमेरिकी हास्य के लिए मार्क ट्वेन पुरस्कार से सम्मानित किया गया। यह कार्यक्रम ऐसे समय में हुआ जब एसोसिएटेड प्रेस ने कला परिसर में "ट्रम्प-युग के उथल-पुथल" का वर्णन किया। द गार्डियन ने डोनाल्ड ट्रम्प के नाम पर एक इमारत का नाम बदलने की असफल कोशिश पर चुटकुले सुनाए जाने का उल्लेख किया।
